metadata.title: Kähler-Finsler rigidity of the Kobayashi metric and the Kähler base of weakly Kähler-Finsler metrics
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we establish a rigidity theorem: for every balanced, smooth, bounded pseudoconvex domain, its Kobayashi metric is a smooth, strongly pseudoconvex, Kähler-Finsler metric restricted on a neighborhood of the origin if and only if the domain is a Hermitian ellipsoid, biholomorphic to the unit ball. Thus for any balanced, smooth, bounded, strictly convex, and strongly pseudoconvex domain that is not biholomorphic to the unit ball, its Kobayashi metric is a non-Kähler-Finsler, weakly Kähler-Finsler metric. We also prove that the base manifold of every weak Kähler-Finsler metric is Kähler.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 对光滑有界 balanced 伪凸域，证明原点邻域的 Kobayashi 度量为光滑强伪凸 Kähler–Finsler 度量当且仅当域是 Hermitian 椭球，并讨论弱 Kähler–Finsler 底空间的 Kähler 性。
analysis.breakthrough: 以局部 Finsler 曲率结构刻画球的线性椭球模型。
analysis.limitations: balanced、光滑和伪凸等条件不能省；底空间 Kähler 性与 Finsler 度量本身 Kähler 性须区分。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
